If several plants in one bed grow poorly: Uma izitshalo ezimbalwa embhedeni owodwa zikhula kabi futhi zinamafindo afanayo, buza isevisi yokuxilonga ukuthi iyazidinga yini izimpande kanye nomhlabathi oyizungezile. If the plum has several trunks, start at: Uma iplamu ineziqu ezimbalwa, qala kufindo elilodwa elimnyama bese ulandelela igatsha lalo phansi esiqwini ngaphambi kokulimaka ukuze lithenwe. Amagatsha awelayo angenza ihlumela elinempilo libonakale lithwele ifindo.

If you find a contact point, create a sm: Uma uthola indawo yokuxhumana, dala igebe elincane noma ubeke kabusha usekelo ngethayi ethambile exegayo. Shiya isibazi sisobala ukuze sibhekwe. Inspect bumps along veins and stems with: Hlola amaqhuqhuva eduze kwemithambo neziqu ngelensi futhi uhlukanise amagobolondo angaphezulu esicutshini sesitshalo.

Inspect folded margins for insects witho: Hlola imingcele egoqiwe ukuze uthole izinambuzane ngaphandle kokuwavula ngenkani. Qaphela umsingathi, isikhathi sekhefu lokuhluma kanye nanoma yikuphi ukupela kwakamuva okubandayo.
